title: Northgate Protect Plan Holding Limits per Customer and per Item
content:
A customer may hold any number of single-item Northgate Protect plans, one for each covered item, but at most 1 Northgate Protect Complete Monthly plan. An item can be covered by only one single-item plan at a time. A single-item plan cannot be bought for an order line that already has a single-item plan in purchased or active status. A plan that is canceled, expired, fulfilled or lapsed no longer counts.

## Basis of the one-plan-per-item test

- **What is compared:** the order line of the item the new plan would cover, against the order lines named on the customer's existing single-item plans.
- **Whose word counts:** the plan records. The test is read from the status of the existing plans before the purchase is made, not from the customer's account of them.
- **Statuses that block:** purchased and active. Canceled, expired, fulfilled and lapsed plans are disregarded.

| Existing single-item plan on the same order line | New single-item plan for that line |
|---|---|
| None | Not blocked by this rule |
| One in purchased status | Cannot be bought |
| One in active status | Cannot be bought |
| One canceled, expired, fulfilled or lapsed | Not blocked by this rule |

## Limits in figures

| Plan kind | Most held by one customer |
|---|---|
| Single-item plans | No maximum (one per covered item) |
| Northgate Protect Complete Monthly | 1 |

*Hypothetical:* a customer whose earlier single-item plan on a soundbar's order line expired last month may buy a new single-item plan for that same line, if the purchase is otherwise allowed; while that earlier plan was still active, no second plan could be bought for the line.
